title: Preserve typed task-sync shared-conflict reasons in partial-import receipts
outcome: Report the actual shared-conflict reason and preserve non-shared refusals without classifying peer-supplied prose.
acceptance: Per-task receipts derive shared conflict reasons from typed data rather than substring searches over messages or origin-machine aliases.
An incoming alias containing a different reason token cannot misclassify an activity conflict, and a publication basis failure retains its actual refusal and remedy.
Existing task-level atomicity and partial-folder behavior remain intact.
